name: How long does window casing repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window casing repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window casing repair depends on the scope of the project. Simple repairs on a single window, such as filling small cracks and repainting, might only take a few hours. More complex repairs involving multiple windows, significant wood replacement, or addressing underlying water damage could take several days. We provide a projected timeline after our initial assessment, considering factors like material availability and weather conditions, especially for exterior work. Setting expectations correctly from the start helps you plan around the work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor fixes to several days for complex projects involving extensive damage or multiple windows.
